definition_zh: 伦理的；道德的；合乎道德的；符合职业道德的
definition_en: relating to moral principles, or agreeing with them
core_image: 天平两端：一端放着行为，一端放着人的品性
scene: 评审委员会先问的不是效果，而是这种做法是否正当。The review board asked whether the trial was ethical before it discussed the results.
sceneCN: 这里 ethical 是「合乎道德的」（第 2 个义项：符合道德标准）；句意：评审委员会在讨论结果之前，先问这项试验是否合乎道德。

pos.zh: 伦理的；道德的；合乎道德的

derivatives.zh: 由 ethic 加复数词尾构成，指伦理学或一套道德准则
un-（不）+ ethical，指不符合道德或行业规范的
ethical 加 -ly 构成，指在道德上、合乎道德地
ethic 加 -ist 构成，指研究伦理问题的学者

senses.title: About moral principles
senses.definition: connected with the principles of right and wrong behaviour
senses.definitionCN: 与是非对错的原则相关的
senses.example: The course covers the ethical questions raised by gene editing.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课程讨论基因编辑引发的伦理问题。
senses.why: Greek ethikos described whatever belonged to the settled character of a person, so the adjective first marks the whole field of character and conduct rather than one approved act.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 ethikos 描述属于一个人稳定品性的东西，所以这个形容词最初标记的是品性与行为的整个领域，而不是某一个被认可的行为。

senses.title: Morally right
senses.definition: morally good or acceptable
senses.definitionCN: 在道德上正当、可以接受的
senses.example: Is it ethical to test the vaccine on children?
senses.exampleCN: 在儿童身上测试这种疫苗合乎道德吗？
senses.why: Once the adjective names the field of morals, it can also say that an act falls on the approved side of that field, and this verdict sense is now the most common.
senses.whyCN: 一旦这个形容词用来指道德这个领域，它也就能表示某个行为落在该领域被认可的一侧，这个「下判断」的义项如今最常用。

senses.title: Following a professional code
senses.definition: acting according to the written rules of a profession such as medicine or law
senses.definitionCN: 按照医学、法律等行业的成文规范行事的
senses.example: The lawyer refused the case on ethical grounds.
senses.exampleCN: 这位律师基于职业道德上的理由拒绝了这个案子。
senses.why: Modern professions turned general morality into printed codes, so in a hospital or a courtroom ethical means obeying the rules of that trade rather than private conscience alone.
senses.whyCN: 现代职业把普遍的道德写成了成文守则，因此在医院或法庭里，ethical 表示遵守本行业的规范，而不只是凭个人良心。

senses.title: Sold on prescription
senses.definition: of a medicine, supplied only with a prescription from a doctor
senses.definitionCN: 指药品只能凭医生处方配售的
senses.example: The same compound is sold as an ethical drug and as a free-sale one.
senses.exampleCN: 同一种化合物既作为处方药出售，也作为自由销售药出售。
senses.why: American pharmacy law split medicines into free-sale goods and professionally supervised ones, and the trade called the supervised group ethical drugs because a licensed judgement stands behind every sale.
senses.whyCN: 美国药房法规把药品分成自由销售与专业监管两类，行业把受监管的一类称作 ethical drug，因为每一次售出背后都有执业者的专业判断。

intro.en: Ethical is built inside English from ethic, which came through Latin from Greek ethikos, an adjective formed on ethos, character.
intro.cn: ethical 是英语在 ethic 后加 -al 构成；ethic 经拉丁语来自希腊语 ethikos，而 ethikos 由 ethos（品性）构成。

items.en: Ethos means character, and also the habitual place where a person or an animal lives.
items.cn: ethos 指品性，也指人或动物惯常居留的地方。

items.en: Ethikos means of or about character, and supplies the stem of the adjective.
items.cn: ethikos 意为关于品性的，提供这个形容词的词干。

items.en: Latin borrows ethicus from Greek as a learned adjective for moral matters.
items.cn: 拉丁语从希腊语借入 ethicus，作为谈论道德的学术形容词。

items.en: Old French ethique carries the noun and the adjective into English.
items.cn: 古法语 ethique 把名词与形容词形式传入英语。

items.en: The suffix -al is added to ethic, giving ethical as a plain adjective of morals.
items.cn: 英语在 ethic 后加后缀 -al，构成表示道德的纯形容词 ethical。

items.en: The word spreads to professional codes, ethical review boards, and ethical drugs.
items.cn: 这个词扩展到职业守则、伦理审查委员会与处方药等说法中。

note.en: Ethical belongs to the ethic family and stands beside the everyday words for right conduct.
note.cn: ethical 属于 ethic 词族，并与日常表示正当行为的词相邻。

entries.definition: a set of moral principles guiding a person or group
entries.definitionCN: 指导个人或群体的道德准则

entries.definition: the study of right and wrong, or a code of conduct
not morally acceptable
concerned with right and wrong behaviour
showing high moral standards in personal conduct
acting on firmly held beliefs about right behaviour

normalIntro.en: Ethical is the adjective of ethos, the settled character that stands behind a life.
normalIntro.cn: ethical 是 ethos 的形容词，ethos 指支撑一生的稳定品性。

normal.en: Ethical standards are the rules a profession writes down.
normal.cn: ethical standards 是一个行业写下来的规矩。

normal.en: An ethical dilemma is a choice where both roads cost something.
normal.cn: ethical dilemma 是两条路都有代价的选择。

normal.en: Ethical approval is the permission a research board gives.
normal.cn: ethical approval 是研究伦理委员会给出的许可。

normal.en: The prefix un- reverses the word: unethical means against the code.
normal.cn: 前缀 un- 把词义反转：unethical 表示违反规范。

normal.en: Compare moral: moral is the wider word, while ethical often points to a written code.
normal.cn: 对比 moral：moral 范围更宽，ethical 常指向成文规范。

abstract.en: Picture a path worn across grass behind one person, the visible line of settled habit.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人身后被踩出的小径，那是稳定习惯留下的可见痕迹，对应第 1 个义项的「品性领域」。

abstract.en: Put that path on one pan of a balance and a single deed on the other, then see which side sinks.
abstract.cn: 把这条小径放在天平一端，把单个行为放在另一端，看哪边下沉，对应第 2 个义项的「落在被认可一侧」。

abstract.en: Then hand the person a printed rule book of the trade and watch which lines get ticked.
abstract.cn: 再递给这个人一本本行业的成文守则，看哪些条款被勾掉，对应第 3 个义项的「成文规范」。

examples.en: The panel raised ethical concerns about the experiment.
examples.cn: 委员会对这项实验提出了伦理方面的担忧。

examples.en: It is not ethical to use the data without consent.
examples.cn: 未经同意就使用这些数据是不道德的。

examples.en: Every hospital needs an ethical review board.
examples.cn: 每家医院都需要一个伦理审查委员会。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「爱思扣」——凡事都要扣问良心、反复思量，才谈得上合乎道德；这只是谐音拆词联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 ethos（品性、习惯）→ ethikos（关于品性的）→ 拉丁语 ethicus → 古法语 ethique → 英语 ethic / ethics → 加 -al 成 ethical，核心义「与品性和是非相关」。

sensesIntro.en: The word runs from the whole domain of character, to an act that passes the moral test, to a printed professional code, and finally to a supervised drug channel.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从品性的整体领域，走到通过道德检验的行为，再走到成文的职业守则，最后走到受监管的药品渠道。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a balance with one deed on a pan and a whole character on the other.
core.cn: 核心意象：天平一端放着单个行为，另一端放着整个人的品性。

branches.en: The domain of morals is the oldest adjectival sense.
branches.cn: 道德领域是这个形容词最古老的义项。

branches.en: Landing on the approved side of that domain yields the verdict sense.
branches.cn: 落在该领域被认可的一侧，就产生了「下判断」的义项。

branches.en: Printed codes turn general morality into a rule sense.
branches.cn: 成文守则把普遍道德变成「守行规」的义项。

branches.en: A supervised drug channel borrows the name because a licensed judgement stands behind it.
branches.cn: 受监管的药品渠道借用这个词，因为每次售出背后都有执业判断。

branches.en: Both the approved act and the code-bound act answer to one standard.
branches.cn: 被认可的行为与受守则约束的行为，面对的是同一套标准。

intro.en: Ethical is a Greek-derived stem with a Latin adjective suffix, and the family around it includes ethics, unethical, and ethically.
intro.cn: ethical 由希腊来源的词干加拉丁形容词后缀构成，周围的词族包括 ethics、unethical 与 ethically。

latinIntro.en: The Latin link is ethicus, a borrowing of Greek ethikos that carried the word into European scholarly language.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语环节是 ethicus，它借自希腊语 ethikos，把这个词带入欧洲的学术语言。

items.example: Ethos names the settled character behind conduct.
items.exampleCN: ethos 指行为背后稳定的品性。

items.example: Ethikos is the adjective built on ethos.
items.exampleCN: ethikos 是由 ethos 构成的形容词。

items.example: Latin ethicus carries the Greek word westward.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语 ethicus 把这个希腊词向西传播。

items.example: A work ethic is a settled attitude to labour.
items.exampleCN: work ethic 是对待劳动的稳定态度。

items.meaningCN: 由名词构成形容词的后缀
items.example: The suffix -ic turns ethos into ethikos.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ic 把 ethos 变成 ethikos。

items.meaningCN: 构成形容词、表示「与……有关」的后缀
items.example: The suffix -al turns ethic into ethical.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -al 把 ethic 变成 ethical。

items.meaning: the study of right and wrong
items.example: Ethics is taught as a separate subject.
items.exampleCN: 伦理学作为一门独立学科来教授。
前缀 un- 构成 unethical。

items.example: Unethical conduct can end a career.
items.exampleCN: 不道德的行为可能断送职业生涯。

definition_zh: 民族的；种族的；民族风情的
definition_en: relating to a group of people with a shared culture or origin
core_image: 一群人穿着相同的传统服饰，围在一起唱歌
scene: 这个街区住着许多不同民族的家庭，节日时格外热闹。This neighborhood is home to families of many ethnic groups, and it becomes lively during festivals.
sceneCN: 这里 ethnic 是「民族的」（第 1 个义项：与共享文化或血统的群体有关）；句意：这个街区住着许多不同民族的家庭，节日时格外热闹。

pos.zh: 民族的；种族的；民族风情的

senses.title: Relating to a people
senses.definition: connected with a group that shares culture, language or origin
senses.definitionCN: 与共享文化、语言或血统的群体有关
senses.example: The city has many ethnic communities.
senses.exampleCN: 这座城市有许多族群社区。
senses.why: The Greek source means nation or people, so ethnic marks what belongs to a people.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语来源意为民族或人民，因此 ethnic 标记属于某个民族的事物。

senses.title: Traditional cultural style
senses.definition: in a traditional style of a particular people
senses.definitionCN: 采用某一民族的传统风格
senses.example: She wore an ethnic dress to the festival.
senses.exampleCN: 她穿了一件民族风连衣裙去参加节日。
senses.why: Culture shows in clothing and design, so ethnic also describes that style.
senses.whyCN: 文化体现在服饰与设计中，因此 ethnic 也描述这种风格。

intro.en: Ethnic comes from Greek ethnos, a nation or people, through Latin ethnicus.
intro.cn: ethnic 经拉丁语 ethnicus 源自希腊语 ethnos（民族、人民）。

items.en: Ethnos means a nation or people.
items.cn: ethnos 意为民族或人民。

items.en: Ethnikos means belonging to a people.
items.cn: ethnikos 意为属于某个民族的。

items.en: Ethnicus carries the word into Latin.
items.cn: ethnicus 把词带入拉丁语。

items.en: Ethnic describes peoples and their cultures.
items.cn: ethnic 描述民族及其文化。

items.en: It also describes traditional styles.
items.cn: 它也描述传统风格。

note.en: Ethnic is close to racial and cultural, but focuses on a people and its culture.
note.cn: ethnic 与种族的、文化的相近，但侧重民族及其文化。

entries.definition: ethnic identity
in ethnic terms
a moral principle
relating to race
relating to culture
relating to a nation

normalIntro.en: Ethnic points to a people: its language, food and festivals.
normalIntro.cn: ethnic 指向一个民族：它的语言、食物与节日。

normal.en: An ethnic group shares a culture.
normal.cn: ethnic group 共享一种文化。

normal.en: An ethnic minority is a smaller people within a country.
normal.cn: ethnic minority 指一国之内人数较少的民族。

normal.en: Ethnic food comes from a particular tradition.
normal.cn: ethnic food 来自特定传统。

normal.en: Ethnic identity is the sense of belonging to a people.
normal.cn: ethnic identity 是归属于某民族的意识。

normal.en: Compare ethic: ethic is about morals, ethnic is about peoples.
normal.cn: 对比 ethic：ethic 关乎道德，ethnic 关乎民族。

abstract.en: Picture a table full of dishes from one tradition.
abstract.cn: 想象一桌来自同一传统的菜肴。

abstract.en: Imagine a song sung in a language you do not know.
abstract.cn: 想象一首用陌生语言唱的歌。

abstract.en: Think of a pattern woven the same way for generations.
abstract.cn: 想象一个世代相传的编织花纹。

examples.en: The school welcomes students from many ethnic backgrounds.
examples.cn: 学校欢迎来自许多民族背景的学生。

examples.en: The market sells ethnic food from around the world.
examples.cn: 市场上出售来自世界各地的民族风味食物。

examples.en: She studies ethnic music of the region.
examples.cn: 她研究该地区的民族音乐。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ethnic」听起来像「爱死尼克」——每个民族都有自己的特色，这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 ethnos（民族、人民）→ ethnikos（民族的）→ 拉丁语 ethnicus → ethnic，核心义「属于某个民族及其文化」。

sensesIntro.en: Ethnic first describes peoples and their shared culture, and then the traditional style that comes from that culture.
sensesIntro.cn: ethnic 先描述民族及其共享文化，再描述由该文化而来的传统风格。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: people in traditional dress singing together.
core.cn: 核心意象：穿着传统服饰的人们一起唱歌。

branches.en: The first sense links a person to a people.
branches.cn: 首要义项把人与其民族联系起来。

branches.en: The second sense describes traditional style.
branches.cn: 第二个义项描述传统风格。

branches.en: Culture shapes the clothing and food people call ethnic.
branches.cn: 文化塑造了人们称为民族风情的服饰与食物。

branches.en: Ethnic identity is a common modern phrase.
branches.cn: ethnic identity 是常见的现代短语。

branches.en: Ethnic design borrows patterns from a tradition.
branches.cn: 民族风格的设计借用传统花纹。

intro.en: Ethnic comes from Greek ethnos, people, with the adjective ending -ic.
intro.cn: ethnic 源自希腊语 ethnos（人民），带形容词词尾 -ic。

latinIntro.en: Latin ethnicus borrowed the Greek word before English took it.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ethnicus 先借入这个希腊词，再传入英语。

items.example: Ethnicus carries the word to Latin.

definition_zh: 民族志；民族志研究方法；民族志著作
definition_en: a written description of a people and their way of life, and the fieldwork method that produces it
core_image: 住在村子里的人，笔记本上记满一整天的琐事
scene: 他背着录音笔住进渔村，一住两年，最后交出一本厚厚的记录。Her ethnography of the fishing village came after two years of living among its people.
sceneCN: 这里 ethnography 是「民族志」（第 1 个义项：对一个民族的书面描述）；句意：她这部渔村民族志，是在村里住了两年之后写成的。

pos.zh: 民族志；民族志研究；民族志著作

derivatives.zh: ethnography 加 -ic 构成，指民族志的、以田野观察为方法的
ethnography 加 -er 构成，指从事民族志工作的研究者
auto-（自身）+ ethnography，指把研究者自己的经历写进田野的民族志

senses.title: A written account of a people
senses.definition: a book or report that describes the way of life of a group of people
senses.definitionCN: 描述一个群体生活方式的著作或报告
senses.example: Her ethnography opens with a market scene at dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 她的民族志以黎明时分的集市场景开篇。
senses.why: Greek graphein means to write, and the second half of the compound is exactly that verb, so the word first names a written product rather than a method.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 graphein 意为书写，而这个词的后半部分正是这个动词，所以它最初命名的是一个写成的成品，而不是一种方法。

senses.title: The fieldwork method
senses.definition: the research method of living among people and observing their ordinary life over a long period
senses.definitionCN: 长期生活在人群之中、观察其日常生活的调查方法
senses.example: He learned ethnography by joining a fishing crew for a season.
senses.exampleCN: 他跟着一支渔船队干了一个季节，借此学会了民族志方法。
senses.why: Such a book can only be made by staying put and watching, so the name slid from the account to the practice that produces the account.
senses.whyCN: 这样的书只有靠住下来长期观察才写得出来，于是名称从「写成的记录」滑向了「生产这份记录的做法」。

senses.title: One particular study
senses.definition: one single study or book about a particular group
senses.definitionCN: 关于某一个特定群体的单项研究或单本著作
senses.example: Two ethnographies of the same street reach opposite conclusions.
senses.exampleCN: 关于同一条街的两部民族志得出了相反的结论。
senses.why: Each account has one author, one place, and one period, so the uncountable name gained a countable use for individual works.
senses.whyCN: 每一份记录都有唯一的作者、地点和时段，于是这个不可数名称发展出可数用法，专指一部部独立作品。

senses.title: A close portrait of any group
senses.titleCN: 对群体生活的细致描绘
senses.definition: a detailed description of the life of a group, borrowed by analogy for workplaces or online communities
senses.definitionCN: 对某个群体生活的细致描述，被类推用于职场或网络社群
senses.example: The article reads like an ethnography of the newsroom.
senses.exampleCN: 这篇文章读起来像是一份关于新闻编辑室的民族志。
senses.why: Because the method aims at dense description of ordinary practice, writers borrow the word for any close portrait of people doing things together.
senses.whyCN: 由于这种方法追求对日常实践的密集描述，写作者便借用这个词，指任何对共同活动的人群所作的细致刻画。

intro.en: Ethnography joins Greek ethnos, a people, with graphein, to write; the compound is recorded in learned Latin before it settles into English.
intro.cn: ethnography 由希腊语 ethnos（民族）与 graphein（书写）组合而成，这个复合形式先见于学术拉丁语，之后才在英语里定型。

items.en: Ethnos means a people or a nation, a group sharing descent and custom.
items.cn: ethnos 指民族或族群，即共享血统与习俗的群体。

items.en: Graphein means to write or to draw, and supplies the second half of the compound.
items.cn: graphein 意为书写或描画，构成复合词的后半部分。

items.en: The joined idea is writing about a people, not merely naming or listing them.
items.cn: 组合起来的意思是「把一个民族写下来」，而不只是给它命名或列举。

items.en: Early modern learned Latin uses ethnographia for descriptions of peoples.
items.cn: 近代早期的学术拉丁语用 ethnographia 指对各个民族的描述。

items.en: English adopts ethnography for the descriptive study of peoples.
items.cn: 英语采用 ethnography，指对民族的描述性研究。

items.en: Fieldwork-based anthropology makes ethnography both its central genre and the name of its method.
items.cn: 以田野工作为基础的人类学，使 ethnography 既是其核心文体，也成为其方法的名称。

note.en: Ethnography is the writing half of the ethno- family, close to the person who does it and to the neighbouring method words.
note.cn: ethnography 是 ethno- 词族中「书写」的那一半，与从事它的人以及相邻的方法类词关系最近。

entries.definition: relating to the description of a people
entries.definitionCN: 民族志的；与民族描述相关的

entries.definition: a researcher who describes a people by living among them
an ethnography that includes the experience of the researcher
entries.definitionCN: 把研究者自身经历写进去的民族志

entries.definition: research carried out in the place where people actually live
the technique of joining a group while observing it
the wider study of human societies and cultures

normalIntro.en: Ethnography is ethnos plus graphein: writing a people down, and then living with them to earn the right to write.
normalIntro.cn: ethnography 是 ethnos 加 graphein：先把一个民族写下来，再住进去，才配得上写。

normal.en: Ethno- marks a people, as it does in ethnic and ethnology.
normal.cn: ethno- 标记「民族」，ethnic 与 ethnology 也是如此。

normal.en: The ending -graphy means writing or drawing, as in geography.
normal.cn: 词尾 -graphy 表示书写或描画，geography 也是这样。

normal.en: An ethnographer is the person who does ethnography.
normal.cn: ethnographer 就是做民族志的那个人。

normal.en: Autoethnography turns the life of the observer into part of the field.
normal.cn: autoethnography 把观察者自己的生活也变成田野的一部分。

normal.en: Compare ethnology: ethnography describes one people, ethnology compares many.
normal.cn: 对比 ethnology：ethnography 描述一个民族，ethnology 比较多个民族。

abstract.en: See a notebook filling with names, meals, and jokes until it becomes a bound book.
abstract.cn: 想象一本笔记被名字、饭菜和玩笑填满，最后装订成一本书，对应第 1 个义项的「写成的记录」。

abstract.en: See the same person sitting for months on a plastic stool in the village square.
abstract.cn: 想象同一个人在小广场的塑料凳上坐了几个月，对应第 2 个义项的「长期田野方法」。

abstract.en: See two such books about one street standing side by side, disagreeing with each other.
abstract.cn: 想象关于同一条街的两本书并排立着，彼此意见相左，对应第 3 个义项的「单部研究」。

examples.en: The ethnography describes how fishermen share the catch.
examples.cn: 这部民族志描述了渔民如何分配渔获。

examples.en: She is writing an ethnography of a hospital ward.
examples.cn: 她正在写一部关于医院病房的民族志。

examples.en: Good ethnography depends on trust built over many months.
examples.cn: 好的民族志依赖许多个月里建立起来的信任。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「ethno 一群人 + graphy 记下来」——像把一村人的日常一条条记进本子；这只是拆词联想，与严格词源考证并不等同。

root: 希腊语 ethnos（民族、族群）+ graphein（书写、描画）→ 学术拉丁语 ethnographia → 英语 ethnography，核心义「把一个民族的生活写下来」。

sensesIntro.en: The word starts as the book, becomes the method that produces the book, then a countable single work, and finally any close portrait of a group.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词先是那本书，再是写出这本书的方法，然后是可数的单部作品，最后泛指任何对群体的细致刻画。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a field notebook that slowly becomes a book about one community.
core.cn: 核心意象：一本田野笔记慢慢变成一部关于某个共同体的书。

branches.en: The written account is the original sense of the compound.
branches.cn: 写成的记录是这个复合词的本义。

branches.en: The method is the practice that makes the account possible.
branches.cn: 研究方法是让这份记录成为可能的做法。

branches.en: A countable work is one bounded product of that method.
branches.cn: 可数的著作是这套方法产出的单件成品。

branches.en: Borrowed for any group, the word becomes a general close portrait.
branches.cn: 被借用于任何群体时，这个词变成泛指的细致刻画。

branches.en: The book and the method share one name because the book is the method made visible.
branches.cn: 书与方法共用一个名称，因为书就是方法留下的可见痕迹。

intro.en: Ethnography is a Greek compound: ethnos, a people, plus -graphy from graphein, to write.
intro.cn: ethnography 是希腊语复合词：ethnos（民族）加 -graphy（源自 graphein，书写）。

latinIntro.en: New Latin ethnographia gave the English word its shape and its learned tone.
latinIntro.cn: 新拉丁语 ethnographia 给了英语这个词的词形与学术语气。

items.example: Ethnos is the first half of the compound.
items.exampleCN: ethnos 是这个复合词的前半部分。

items.example: The prefix ethno- builds ethnic and ethnology.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 ethno- 构成 ethnic 与 ethnology。

items.example: The suffix -graphy appears in geography too.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -graphy 也出现在 geography 中。

items.example: Ethnographia is the learned Latin form.
items.exampleCN: ethnographia 是学术拉丁语形式。

items.meaning: description of a people by close observation
items.example: Ethnography keeps both the book and the method.
items.exampleCN: ethnography 同时保留「书」与「方法」两层。

items.example: Ethnographic notes are dense and dated.
items.exampleCN: 民族志笔记既密集又标注日期。

items.meaningCN: 表示「做某事的人」的后缀

items.example: An ethnographer lives where the group lives.
items.exampleCN: 民族志研究者住在所研究群体的所在地。
前缀 auto- 构成 autoethnography。

definition_zh: 民族学家；民族学研究者
definition_en: a scholar who studies the cultures, customs, and social life of particular peoples, often by living among them and comparing many societies
core_image: 村口坐着一位记录者，把歌谣、亲属称谓与器物一件件写进本子
scene: 雨林边的村子里，一位研究者把婚礼上唱的歌谣记满整本笔记。The ethnologist spent two years recording songs and kinship terms in the village.
sceneCN: 这里 ethnologist 是「做田野记录的民族学家」（第 2 个义项：长期住在社区里做记录的研究者）；句意：这位民族学家在村子里花了两年时间记录歌谣与亲属称谓。

pos.zh: 民族学家；民族学研究者

collocations.zh: 做田野调查的民族学家
受过专业训练的民族学家

derivatives.zh: 由 ethno-（族群）与 -logy（学科）构成，义为「民族学」
由 ethnology 加形容词后缀 -ical 构成，义为「民族学的」
由 ethno- 与 -graphy（书写、记录）构成，义为「民族志；民族志研究」
由 ethnography 加 -er 构成，义为「民族志研究者」

senses.title: A specialist in ethnology
senses.titleCN: 民族学家：民族学的专门研究者
senses.definition: a scholar trained in ethnology, the systematic and comparative study of peoples and their cultures
senses.definitionCN: 受过民族学训练、以比较方法系统研究族群及其文化的学者
senses.example: The department hired an ethnologist to teach comparative kinship.
senses.exampleCN: 系里聘了一位民族学家来讲授比较亲属制度。
senses.why: The Greek pieces are ethnos, a people, and -logia, a study, while -ist marks the person who practises; so an ethnologist is literally the person whose trade is the study of peoples.
senses.whyCN: 这个词由希腊语 ethnos「族群」与 -logia「学科」构成，再由 -ist 标出从事者；ethnologist 字面上就是「以研究族群为业的人」。

senses.title: A fieldworker among a community
senses.definition: a researcher who lives for a time within a community and records its customs, songs, kinship terms, and daily routines at first hand
senses.definitionCN: 在一段时间内住进某个社区、直接记录其风俗、歌谣、亲属称谓与日常生活的研究者
senses.example: As a field ethnologist she spent a year in the fishing village.
senses.exampleCN: 作为田野民族学家，她在一个渔村住了一年。
senses.why: Ethnology rests on evidence gathered in person, so the -ist also names the person who sits in the village and writes down what happens there, not just the one who reads about it.
senses.whyCN: 民族学建立在亲自收集的材料上，因此 -ist 也指那个坐在村子里把见闻写下来的人，而不只是读二手材料的人。

senses.title: A collector and classifier of material culture
senses.titleCN: 物质文化的采集与整理者
senses.definition: a person who collects, labels, and orders objects, recordings, and photographs taken from a people so that they can be studied and displayed
senses.definitionCN: 采集、标注并整理来自某个族群的器物、录音与照片，以便研究与展出的人
senses.example: The museum sent an ethnologist to catalogue the masks and baskets.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆派了一位民族学家去整理面具与篮筐的藏品。
senses.why: Early ethnology depended on objects shipped home from the field, and the same -ist came to name the person who ordered and labelled those collections.
senses.whyCN: 早期民族学依赖从田野运回本国的实物，同一个 -ist 也就用来指整理、标注这些藏品的人。

senses.title: A nineteenth-century classifier of societies
senses.titleCN: 十九世纪的社会分类者
senses.definition: a scholar in the older tradition that arranged human societies on a single scale of development, a usage now largely replaced by anthropologist
senses.definitionCN: 属于旧传统的学者，把人类社会排在一条发展阶梯上；这一用法如今大多已被 anthropologist 取代
senses.example: The ethnologist of that era grouped societies into stages of progress.
senses.exampleCN: 那个时代的民族学家把社会归入不同的进步阶段。
senses.why: The word entered English when the study of peoples was organised around stages of development, so ethnologist carries that historical sense of ranking societies, which modern anthropology rejects.
senses.whyCN: 这个词进入英语时，族群研究正围绕「发展阶段」组织起来，因此 ethnologist 带有给社会排等级的历史含义，而现代人类学已不接受这种做法。

intro.en: Ethnologist is a modern compound of Greek ethnos, a people, and -logia, a study, with the agent suffix -ist.
intro.cn: ethnologist 是近代构成的复合词：希腊语 ethnos「族群」加 -logia「学科」，再加表示从事者的 -ist。

items.en: Ethnos means a people, a nation, or a band living together, and it is also the root of ethnic.
items.cn: ethnos 意为族群、民族或共同生活的一群人，也是 ethnic 的词根。

items.en: -logia, from logos, means a speaking or a reasoned account, and it became the suffix for a field of study.
items.cn: -logia 出自 logos，意为言说或有条理的论述，后来成为表示学科的后缀。

items.en: French scholars coined ethnologie for the comparative study of peoples; the exact first date is uncertain.
items.cn: 法国学者造出 ethnologie 一词，指对各民族的比较研究；确切首见年代不确定。

items.en: English took ethnology in the 1840s and formed ethnologist with -ist for the person.
items.cn: 英语在十九世纪四十年代引入 ethnology，并用 -ist 构成 ethnologist 指人。

items.en: The older ranking of societies has been dropped, and anthropologist now covers most of the work that ethnologist once named.
items.cn: 给社会排等级的旧做法已被放弃，如今 anthropologist 覆盖了 ethnologist 原先所指的大部分工作。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the ethno- family; the near-meaning group gathers neighbouring disciplines that also study people.
note.cn: 形近组收 ethno- 这一词族；近义组收同样研究人的相邻学科。

entries.definition: the academic study of peoples and cultures, the discipline the ethnologist practises
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「民族学」，即民族学家从事的学科。

entries.definition: the descriptive recording of a particular people, the writing side of the work
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「民族志」，指对某个族群的具体描述与记录，是这项工作的书写一面。

entries.definition: an adjective meaning relating to ethnology or to its methods
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「民族学的」，由 ethnology 加 -ical 构成。

entries.definition: a scholar of humanity in the broadest sense, of which ethnology is usually counted a part
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「人类学家」，研究范围最广，民族学通常被视为其中一部分。

entries.definition: a scholar who studies societies and social groups, usually with statistics and surveys rather than fieldwork
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「社会学家」，研究社会与社会群体，多用统计与问卷，而非田野调查。

entries.definition: a scholar who collects and studies the tales, songs, and beliefs of a people
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「民俗学家」，收集并研究一个族群的传说、歌谣与信仰。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the real Greek pieces of the word and the phrases it actually appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用这个词真实的希腊语构件，以及它实际出现的搭配。

normal.en: Ethnos is a people, -logia is a study, and -ist is the person who does it.
normal.cn: ethnos 是族群，-logia 是学科，-ist 是从事的人。

normal.en: Ethnology is the discipline, and an ethnologist is the one who practises it.
normal.cn: ethnology 是学科，ethnologist 是从事这门学科的人。

normal.en: Fieldwork is the mark of the trade, so a field ethnologist is the most typical phrase.
normal.cn: 田野工作是这一行的标志，所以 field ethnologist 是最典型的说法。

normal.en: Ethnography is the writing: an ethnologist gathers, and an ethnography records.
normal.cn: ethnography 是书写成果：ethnologist 去收集，ethnography 把所见记录下来。

normal.en: Compare anthropologist: broader training, while ethnologist names the study of particular peoples.
normal.cn: 对比 anthropologist：训练范围更广，而 ethnologist 侧重对具体族群的研究。

abstract.en: Picture a desk piled with kinship charts and a shelf of monographs, the room of a specialist.
abstract.cn: 想象一张堆满亲属关系图表的书桌和一架专著，那是专门研究者的房间。

abstract.en: Picture the same person sitting on a stone at the edge of a village, notebook open, writing while a wedding song is sung.
abstract.cn: 想象同一个人坐在村口的石头上，摊开笔记本，在婚礼歌声中记录。

abstract.en: Picture a museum store room where masks and baskets lie in numbered trays, each label written by that person.
abstract.cn: 想象博物馆的库房，面具与篮筐躺在编了号的托盘里，每张标签都出自那人之手。

examples.en: The ethnologist published a detailed account of the island marriage customs.
examples.cn: 这位民族学家发表了关于该岛婚姻习俗的详细记述。

examples.en: Two ethnologists compared the kinship terms of the two villages.
examples.cn: 两位民族学家比较了两个村子的亲属称谓。

examples.en: Her training as an ethnologist made her careful with every word she recorded.
examples.cn: 民族学的训练让她对记录的每个词都十分谨慎。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「艾斯诺 · 洛吉斯特」——谐音像「爱琢磨族群的记录者」，只是读音联想，与词源无关。

root: 希腊语 ethnos（族群、民族）＋ -logia（学科、论述）＋ -ist（从事者）→ 近代法语 ethnologie → 英语 ethnology 与 ethnologist；核心义「以族群为研究对象的人」。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses trace one profession: the trained specialist, the fieldworker, the keeper of collections, and the older classifier of societies.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项顺着同一种职业展开：受过训练的专门研究者、田野中的记录者、藏品的整理者，以及旧式的社会分类者。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a note-taker at the edge of a village, writing down songs, kinship terms, and objects.
core.cn: 核心意象：村口的记录者，把歌谣、亲属称谓与器物写进本子。

branches.en: THE DISCIPLINE: the trained scholar is the core sense of the word.
branches.cn: 学科线：受过训练的研究者是这个词的核心义项。

branches.en: THE FIELD: living among a community turns the scholar into a note-taker.
branches.cn: 田野线：住进社区，使学者成为记录者。

branches.en: THE STORE ROOM: objects taken home need someone to order and label them.
branches.cn: 库房线：运回本国的实物需要有人整理与标注。

branches.en: THE OLD SCALE: the nineteenth-century habit of ranking societies left its mark on the word.
branches.cn: 旧阶梯线：十九世纪给社会排等级的习惯在词里留下痕迹。

branches.en: The specialist and the fieldworker are the same person at two points in the work.
branches.cn: 专门研究者与田野记录者是同一个人在工作中的两个阶段。

intro.en: Ethnologist is built from Greek pieces: ethnos, -logia, and the agent suffix -ist.
intro.cn: ethnologist 由希腊语构件搭成：ethnos、-logia 与表示从事者的 -ist。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source word behind ethnologist; the classical suffix -logia was itself borrowed from Greek, so the Latin list is left empty.
latinIntro.cn: ethnologist 背后没有对应的拉丁语源词；古典拉丁语的 -logia 本身借自希腊语，因此拉丁同源词一栏留空。

items.example: Ethnos is the first element of the word.
items.exampleCN: ethnos 是这个词的第一部分。

items.example: The suffix -logia names a field of study.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -logia 表示一门学科。

items.example: The combining form ethno- opens a whole family.
items.exampleCN: 构词成分 ethno- 开启了一整个词族。

items.meaning: the study of peoples and cultures

items.exampleCN: 它把 ethnology 变成 ethnologist。

items.example: The noun names the person, not the field.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词指人，不指学科。

items.meaning: the written description of a people
items.example: Ethnography is the written result of the fieldwork.
items.exampleCN: ethnography 是田野工作的书写成果。

definition_zh: 民族学；人种学；对民族的比较研究
definition_en: the comparative study of peoples and their cultures
core_image: 把许多民族的语言、亲缘与器物摆在一张长桌上比较
scene: 博物馆的展柜按语言与亲缘把各民族的器物并排摆开，这种排列背后是一门比较的学问。Comparative ethnology groups peoples by language, kinship, and material culture.
sceneCN: 这里 ethnology 是「民族学」（第 1 个义项：对各民族进行比较研究的学科）；句意：比较民族学按语言、亲缘关系与物质文化给各民族归类。

derivatives.zh: ethnology 加 -ical 构成，指民族学的、以比较方法研究民族的
ethnology 加 -ist 构成，指研究民族学的学者
ethno-（民族）+ history，指结合文献与民族材料的民族史研究
ethno-（民族）+ linguistics，指研究语言与民族文化关系的学科

senses.title: The comparative study of peoples
senses.definition: the branch of learning that compares the cultures, languages, and social forms of different peoples
senses.definitionCN: 比较不同民族的文化、语言与社会形态的学科
senses.example: Ethnology asks why neighbouring peoples organise kinship so differently.
senses.exampleCN: 民族学追问：为什么相邻民族的亲属制度差别如此之大。
senses.why: Greek logos means reasoned account, so ethnology is not the writing of one people but reasoned comparison across many, which is why the word names a general science.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 logos 意为有理据的论说，所以 ethnology 不是写下某一个民族，而是对许多民族作有理据的比较，因此它命名的是一门总体性的学问。

senses.title: The study of origins and distribution
senses.definition: the older programme of classifying peoples by origin, migration, and physical or cultural traits
senses.definitionCN: 较早的研究纲领，按起源、迁徙以及体质或文化特征给民族分类
senses.example: Nineteenth-century ethnology often mixed classification with speculation.
senses.exampleCN: 十九世纪的民族学常把分类与猜测混在一起。
senses.why: When the discipline was young, its main task was to place peoples on a map of descent and migration, and that historical programme still colours one sense of the word.
senses.whyCN: 这门学科年轻时，主要任务是把各民族放到血统与迁徙的地图上，这个历史阶段的纲领至今仍构成该词的一个义项。

senses.title: Knowledge of one people or region
senses.titleCN: 对某一民族或地区的研究
senses.definition: the accumulated body of study devoted to a particular people or area
senses.definitionCN: 针对某个民族或某个地区积累起来的研究成果
senses.example: The museum holds a strong collection in the ethnology of the northern peoples.
senses.exampleCN: 这家博物馆在北方各民族的民族学研究上收藏颇丰。
senses.why: Like other names ending in -ology, it can shift from the whole discipline to the total knowledge about one object, so a library can hold the ethnology of a single region.
senses.whyCN: 和其他以 -ology 结尾的学科名一样，它可以从整门学科转指关于某一对象的全部知识，所以一座图书馆可以收藏某一地区的民族学研究。

intro.en: Ethnology joins Greek ethnos, a people, with -logia, from logos, reasoned account or study.
intro.cn: ethnology 由希腊语 ethnos（民族）与 -logia（源自 logos，论说、研究）组合而成。

items.en: Ethnos means a people or a nation, a group sharing descent and custom.
items.cn: ethnos 指民族或族群，即共享血统与习俗的群体。

items.en: Logos means word, account, or reasoned discourse.
items.cn: logos 指言词、叙述或有理据的论说。

items.en: The ending -logia names a field of study or a body of accounts.
items.cn: 词尾 -logia 表示某一研究领域或一批论述。

items.en: Scholars of the eighteenth century coin ethnologia for the study of peoples.
items.cn: 十八世纪的学者造出 ethnologia 一词，指对民族的研究。

items.en: English adopts ethnology for the classification and comparison of peoples.
items.cn: 英语采用 ethnology，指对各民族的分类与比较。

items.en: As anthropology takes over fieldwork, ethnology narrows toward comparison and regional knowledge.
items.cn: 随着人类学接管田野工作，ethnology 的范围收窄，转向比较与区域知识。

note.en: Ethnology is the comparing half of the ethno- family, next to its own adjective and person noun, and to the neighbouring social sciences.
note.cn: ethnology 是 ethno- 词族中「比较研究」的那一半，与它自己的形容词、人物名词以及相邻的社会科学为伍。
